source.behavior: Open the authenticated System Health screen for the active tenant without mutating application state.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The explicit route renders the production tenant React shell only after authenticated tenant context resolution and server-side tenant.view plus diagnostics.view authorization.

runtime_path: production app view / System Health workspace

authorization.tenant_context: tenant.context resolves the active membership from the route tenant
authorization.direct_id_surface: none beyond the tenant slug; user_id, membership_id, site, and query tenant values are not route authority

tenant_isolation.proof: Tenant A cannot open Tenant B System Health route without an active membership. The controller authorizes only after TenantContext is established, and caller query probes do not replace the route-derived active tenant.

semantics.csrf: not applicable: the canonical route is GET/HEAD only and POST returns 405
semantics.persistence: no membership or role state is created or changed by repeated GET
semantics.authoritative_reread: route access is re-authorized from the current authenticated session, active TenantContext, and current RBAC state on every request
semantics.secrets: server configuration sentinel is not rendered
semantics.wordpress_connector: not invoked by this route operation; System Health child controls/data operations are separate canonical operations
semantics.queue_cache_scheduler: not invoked or mutated by this route operation
semantics.fake_success: none; the route either renders after authorization or returns the real redirect/403/404/405 failure

scope_exclusions: AIMW-IDEN-FC900E61B8 CurrentUserChip System Health link (already terminal)
AIMW-BILL-48E69F42EB System Health Copy Summary control
notes: The real System Health route runtime was already merged by PR #508 as supporting security enforcement for a separate visible-control operation. This closure adds operation-specific route terminality proof and does not duplicate or claim the System Health child controls.
